description_en:
Queries identification records of security identification results by paging.
Online version: v5.4.2
description_zh:
分页查询安全识别结果的识别记录。
上线版本：v5.4.2
kebab_example: aliyun dataphin-public list-security-identify-records --op-tenant-id 30001011 --list-query TableName=t_test DatasourceName=test Keyword=test PageSize=20 TableCatalog=test IsDatasourceTable=true PageNo=1 FieldName=col1 DatasourceEnv=DEV --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSecurityIdentifyRecords

fields.help_en: Specifies whether the table is a datasource table. Default value: false (treated as a Dataphin table)
fields.help_zh: 是否数据源表, 默认否(视为Dataphin表)
fields.name: is_datasource_table

fields.help_en: The datasource name. This parameter is required only for datasource tables
fields.help_zh: 数据源名称,仅数据源表需要填写
fields.name: datasource_name

fields.help_en: The datasource environment identifier. This parameter is required only for datasource tables
fields.help_zh: 数据源环境标识,仅数据源表需要填写
fields.name: datasource_env

fields.help_en: The table catalog. For datasource tables, specify the database or schema name. For Dataphin physical tables, specify the project name in English. For Dataphin logical tables, specify the business unit name in English
fields.help_zh: 表Catalog,数据源表请填写所属db或schema名称；Dataphin物理表请填写项目英文名；Dataphin逻辑表请填写板块英文名
fields.name: table_catalog

fields.help_en: The search keyword. The search scope is the field name
fields.help_zh: 搜索词范围: 字段名称
fields.name: keyword

fields.help_en: The number of records per page. Default value: 20
fields.name: page_size
